sunrise.mods.screen.sunrise.description: Sunrise is a Rust reimplementation of Minecraft: Java Edition. Mods in the sunrise-mods folder extend it.
sunrise.extras.mod_audio_streams.tooltip: Mods can play audio they make (voice chat, a radio, a music player). Off, all of it plays on unheard.
sunrise.get_the_game.about: This is the game the Sunrise launcher installs and starts. On its own it has none of Minecraft's files, so it can't start.
sunrise.get_the_game.download: Download the launcher at %s, then press Play there.
sunrise.get_the_game.minecraft: Sunrise needs your own copy of Minecraft: Java Edition. The launcher signs you in and prepares the game files from it.
sunrise.get_the_game.title: Start Sunrise from the launcher
